INSERT INTO transactions
           (account_id, date, amount_minor, status, payee_id, raw_description, source,
            external_id, dedupe_key, last_seen_at, sync_flag, possible_duplicate_of)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'provider', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         RETURNING id AS "id!: i64"
